runs.name: p1-drop-default
runs.description: default scene, 20 hand-made predators (engulf 1, kin sparing 0, size 1.25) dropped in the spot at 5 min, 30 min

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(), s = moire.light.params.mode === 'spot' ? moire.light.spot() : null; const pts = []; for (let k = 0; k < 20; k++) { const a = 2 * Math.PI * k / 20 + 0.3; if (s) { const r = s.r * (0.2 + 0.6 * ((k * 7) % 10) / 10); pts.push([s.x + r * Math.cos(a), s.y + r * Math.sin(a)]); } else pts.push([v.cssW * (0.1 + 0.8 * ((k * 0.618034) % 1)), v.cssH * (0.1 + 0.8 * ((k * 0.381966 + 0.2) % 1))]); } return await moire.predators.place(pts)
const C = moire.predators.census; return JSON.stringify({t: C.time, genes: C.genes, now: C.now, total: C.total, recent: C.recent, all: C.all, clusters: C.clusters, digest: C.digest})
const C = moire.predators.census; return JSON.stringify({t: C.time, genes: C.genes, now: C.now, total: C.total, recent: C.recent, all: C.all, clusters: C.clusters, digest: C.digest})
const C = moire.predators.census; return JSON.stringify({t: C.time, genes: C.genes, now: C.now, total: C.total, recent: C.recent, all: C.all, clusters: C.clusters, digest: C.digest})
